name: encrypt
description: Encrypted message vault with bring-your-own-circuit cryptography — you upload the circuit (a python module exposing encrypt/decrypt), the module runs it server-side in a sandbox, and only the ciphertext is kept, stored as a CID in the store mod. Keys are never persisted. Every circuit and every message can be downloaded back and deleted server-side.

status.docs: Module status: store reachability, sandbox isolation, circuit/message counts

me.docs: Caller address + the store identity your uploads land under

circuits.docs: GET list circuits (own + public); POST upload a circuit (multipart file or {source,name,public}) — validated by an encrypt→decrypt roundtrip in the sandbox and pinned to the store; DELETE /circuits/{id} removes it server-side

circuit_source.docs: GET /circuits/{id}/source — download the circuit you brought (owner, or any public circuit)

circuit_install.docs: POST /circuits/install {cid} — install a circuit someone shared by store CID

messages.docs: GET list your messages (metadata only); POST {circuit,key,text|data_b64,label,public,burn} — encrypts server-side with your circuit, stores the ciphertext in the store mod, returns the CID. The key is used in memory and never written anywhere

message_open.docs: POST /messages/{id}/open {key} — fetch the ciphertext from the store and decrypt it server-side with the same circuit; burn-after-read messages delete themselves on success

message_download.docs: GET /messages/{id}/download[?burn=1] — raw ciphertext bytes, to decrypt yourself with your own copy of the circuit

message_delete.docs: DELETE /messages/{id} — removes the object from the store and drops the metadata. DELETE /messages purges every message you own

message_attach.docs: POST /messages/attach {cid,circuit,label} — register a blob you encrypted client-side and uploaded to the store yourself (the server never sees the key or the plaintext)

message_publish.docs: POST /messages/{id}/publish {public} — flip the stored ciphertext public/private in the store

env.ENCRYPT_STORE_URL: store mod gateway (default: config store_url / http://localhost:50152)
env.ENCRYPT_ACTIVATOR_URL: activator control plane, used to wake a slept store (default: config activator_url / http://localhost:9000)
env.ENCRYPT_KEY: Local key name used to mint a protocol token for CLI calls (default: the default mod key)
env.ENCRYPT_SANDBOX_USER: Unix user the circuit process drops to when the API runs as root (default: config sandbox.user)
